note: xargs.sty and verbatim.sty, hand-listed in engine-build/tex-files.extra.json for stanli (whose \newcommandx comes from xargs) and for preambles that \usepackage{verbatim}. There is no fixture closure for them: the LaTeX that collects tex_files never loads these two unless a preamble asks, so the list carries them forever only as extras. This fixture exercises the load.
